serious.description: The 'Expand button' (12) appears after a series of navigation links (7-11) that seem to be sub-items of 'Ministria' (6), but before the next main navigation item 'Tema' (13). This placement is illogical and disrupts the expected sequential flow. A similar issue occurs with 'Expand button' (19) after sub-items (14-18) of 'Tema'. This makes it unclear what the 'Expand button' controls and breaks the predictable visual and functional order of navigation.
serious.suggestion: Ensure that expand/collapse buttons for navigation sections are placed immediately adjacent to the parent item they control, or before their respective sub-items if those sub-items are revealed by the button. The focus order should follow the visual hierarchy: main navigation item, then its expand/collapse control (if any), then its sub-items (if expanded), then the next main navigation item. Avoid placing unrelated or ambiguous 'Expand buttons' in the middle of a navigation sequence.

issues: An h2 heading duplicates the h1 heading, creating redundancy and confusing hierarchy.
H3 headings are not semantically nested under their parent h2, indicating a broken content structure.
A functional element ('Мени за пристапност') is used as a content heading, which is inappropriate.
Headings at the same level (h2) lack comparable importance, mixing news articles with general sections and functional elements.
Some headings are vague or non-descriptive (e.g., a person's name as a heading).
missingSections: Section for 'About the Ministry' (За министерството) including 'Minister', 'Deputy Minister', 'State Secretary', 'Internal Organization'.
Section for 'Topics' (Теми) including 'EU Membership', 'NATO Membership', 'Economic Diplomacy', 'Regional Initiatives', 'Multilateral Relations'.
Section for 'Consular Services' (Конзуларни услуги) including 'Macedonian Citizens' and 'Foreign Citizens'.
Section for 'Public Relations' (Односи со јавност) including 'Announcements', 'Press Conferences', 'Interviews', 'Publications', 'Accreditations'.
Section for 'Agreements, Resolutions and Measures' (Договори, резолуции и мерки) including 'International Agreements' and 'Restrictive Measures'.
vagueHeadings: Министерство за надворешни работи и надворешна трговија
suggestions: Ensure each heading level represents a logical subdivision of the content above it.
Remove the duplicate h2 'Министерство за надворешни работи и надворешна трговија' or rephrase it to introduce a distinct section.

Re-evaluate the nesting of h3s; 'Дипломатски и Конзуларни претставништва...' and 'Тимчо Муцунски' should be h2s if they are main sections, or properly nested if they are sub-sections of a relevant parent.
Replace 'Мени за пристапност' with a link or button, not a heading.
Add descriptive headings for clearly identifiable content sections such as 'About the Ministry', 'Topics', 'Consular Services', 'Public Relations', and 'Agreements, Resolutions and Measures'.
Ensure all headings are descriptive of the content they introduce, avoiding names or generic phrases as standalone headings.
items.summary: The page's heading structure has serious semantic issues, including incorrect hierarchy, duplicate and vague headings, and missing headings for significant content sections, making navigation difficult for screen reader users.

complexSentences: Евро-атлантската и европската интеграција се главни приоритети во нашето работење, воедно залагајќи се за безбеден, стабилен и просперитетен регион, како и развивање на поширока билатерална и мултилатерална соработка.

Во врска со трагичната несреќа што се случи во Кочани, Министерството за надворешни работи и надворешна трговија споделува контакт податоци од надлежните лица во македонските дипломатско-конзуларни претставништва, во земјите каде се хоспитализирани наши државјани.
jargonFound: Стоки и технологии со двојна употреба
passiveVoiceExamples: Во листата на контакти вклучени се и претставништвата во земјите кои понудиле помош за хоспитализација и лекување.
positives: The navigation menu is clearly structured with concise headings.
The cookie consent message is simple and direct.
The descriptive text about North Macedonia is engaging and easy to understand.
improvements: Provide a glossary or tooltips for specialized diplomatic and administrative terms to aid understanding.
Break down long sentences into shorter, more digestible ones, especially in the mission statement and critical announcements.
Offer a 'plain language' version or summary for complex topics like 'dual-use goods and technologies' or 'restrictive measures'.
items.summary: The website content uses a significant amount of specialized diplomatic and administrative jargon, making it challenging for a lower-secondary education level audience. While navigation is clear, key informational paragraphs contain complex sentence structures and vocabulary that hinder overall readability for the target WCAG standard.

evaluation.summary: The Albanian content is generally fluent, natural, and adheres to standard literary Albanian. However, several user interface elements are left untranslated in English, and the HTML lang attribute is incorrectly set to 'al' instead of 'sq', which impacts accessibility.
recommendations: Correct the HTML lang attribute from 'al' to 'sq' to ensure proper language identification for assistive technologies.
Translate all remaining English user interface elements (e.g., 'Menu toggler', 'Toggle search', 'Expand button', 'Open Link here', 'Accessibility button') into Albanian.
Ensure consistency in language for all interactive elements and labels across the website.

issues: The 'Expand button' (12) appears after a series of navigation links (7-11) that seem to be sub-items of 'Ministria' (6), but before the next main navigation item 'Tema' (13). This placement is illogical and disrupts the expected sequential flow. A similar issue occurs with 'Expand button' (19) after sub-items (14-18) of 'Tema'. This makes it unclear what the 'Expand button' controls and breaks the predictable visual and functional order of navigation.
items.suggestion: Ensure that expand/collapse buttons for navigation sections are placed immediately adjacent to the parent item they control, or before their respective sub-items if those sub-items are revealed by the button. The focus order should follow the visual hierarchy: main navigation item, then its expand/collapse control (if any), then its sub-items (if expanded), then the next main navigation item. Avoid placing unrelated or ambiguous 'Expand buttons' in the middle of a navigation sequence.
